card.name: Stirling PDF
card.summary_zh: 编辑、转换和自动处理 PDF 的工具，支持自托管。
field_notes: 运行平台尚未核定，留空

zh:
Stirling PDF - 开源 PDF 平台

Stirling PDF 是一个开源 PDF 编辑平台。你可以将它作为个人桌面应用、在浏览器中运行，或部署到自己的服务器并使用私有 API。无需将文档发送给外部服务，即可编辑、签署、遮盖、转换 PDF 并自动化处理。

![Stirling PDF - Dashboard](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF/c687f2f5eb915b72900ae6c5890d352751ec844f/docs/images/home-light.png) ## 主要功能 - **适用多种工作场景** - 桌面客户端、浏览器界面，以及带私有 API 的自托管服务器。 - **50 多种 PDF 工具** - 编辑、合并、拆分、签署、遮盖、转换、OCR、压缩等。 - **自动化与工作流** - 在界面中直接构建无代码流程，并通过 API 处理数百万份 PDF。 - **面向企业** - 单点登录、审计与灵活的本地部署。 - **开发者平台** - 几乎所有工具都提供 REST API，可集成到现有系统中。 - **多语言界面** - 界面提供 40 多种语言。 完整功能列表请参阅文档： **https://docs.stirlingpdf.com** ## 快速开始 ```bash docker run -p 8080:8080 docker.stirlingpdf.com/stirlingtools/stirling-pdf ``` 然后打开： http://localhost:8080 完整安装选项（包括桌面版和 Kubernetes）请参阅[文档指南](https://docs.stirlingpdf.com/#documentation-guide). ## 资源 - [**文档**](https://docs.stirlingpdf.com) - [**官网**](https://stirling.com) - [**API 文档**](https://registry.scalar.com/@stirlingpdf/apis/stirling-pdf-processing-api/) - [**服务器方案与企业版**](https://docs.stirlingpdf.com/Paid-Offerings) ## 支持 - **社区**： [Discord](https://discord.gg/HYmhKj45pU) - **错误报告**： [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF/issues) ## 参与贡献 欢迎贡献！请参阅 [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF/blob/c687f2f5eb915b72900ae6c5890d352751ec844f/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md)了解相关指南。 本项目使用 [Task](https://taskfile.dev/) 作为构建、开发和测试命令的统一运行工具。运行 `task dev` 启动编辑器，运行 `task` 查看最常用命令，或参阅[开发者指南](https://github.com/Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF/blob/c687f2f5eb915b72900ae6c5890d352751ec844f/docs/developer/DeveloperGuide.md)了解完整详情。 添加翻译请参阅[翻译指南](https://github.com/Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF/blob/c687f2f5eb915b72900ae6c5890d352751ec844f/docs/developer/HowToAddNewLanguage.md). ## 许可证 Stirling PDF 采用开放核心模式。详情请参阅 [LICENSE](https://github.com/Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF/blob/c687f2f5eb915b72900ae6c5890d352751ec844f/LICENSE)。
en:
Stirling PDF - The Open-Source PDF Platform

Stirling PDF is a powerful, open-source PDF editing platform. Run it as a personal desktop app, in the browser, or deploy it on your own servers with a private API. Edit, sign, redact, convert, and automate PDFs without sending documents to external services.

![Stirling PDF - Dashboard](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF/c687f2f5eb915b72900ae6c5890d352751ec844f/docs/images/home-light.png) ## Key Capabilities - **Everywhere you work** - Desktop client, browser UI, and self-hosted server with a private API. - **50+ PDF tools** - Edit, merge, split, sign, redact, convert, OCR, compress, and more. - **Automation & workflows** - No-code pipelines direct in UI with APIs to process millions of PDFs. - **Enterprise‑grade** - SSO, auditing, and flexible on‑prem deployments. - **Developer platform** - REST APIs available for nearly all tools to integrate into your existing systems. - **Global UI** - Interface available in 40+ languages. For a full feature list, see the docs: **https://docs.stirlingpdf.com** ## Quick Start ```bash docker run -p 8080:8080 docker.stirlingpdf.com/stirlingtools/stirling-pdf ``` Then open: http://localhost:8080 For full installation options (including desktop and Kubernetes), see our [Documentation Guide](https://docs.stirlingpdf.com/#documentation-guide). ## Resources - [**Documentation**](https://docs.stirlingpdf.com) - [**Homepage**](https://stirling.com) - [**API Docs**](https://registry.scalar.com/@stirlingpdf/apis/stirling-pdf-processing-api/) - [**Server Plan & Enterprise**](https://docs.stirlingpdf.com/Paid-Offerings) ## Support - **Community**: [Discord](https://discord.gg/HYmhKj45pU) - **Bug Reports**: [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF/issues) ## Contributing We welcome contributions! Please see [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF/blob/c687f2f5eb915b72900ae6c5890d352751ec844f/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md) for guidelines. This project uses [Task](https://taskfile.dev/) as a unified command runner for all build, dev, and test commands. Run `task dev` to get started running the editor, run `task` to see the most common commands, or see the [Developer Guide](https://github.com/Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF/blob/c687f2f5eb915b72900ae6c5890d352751ec844f/docs/developer/DeveloperGuide.md) for full details. For adding translations, see the [Translation Guide](https://github.com/Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF/blob/c687f2f5eb915b72900ae6c5890d352751ec844f/docs/developer/HowToAddNewLanguage.md). ## License Stirling PDF is open-core. See [LICENSE](https://github.com/Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF/blob/c687f2f5eb915b72900ae6c5890d352751ec844f/LICENSE) for details.
